label: 1 Thessalonians 1:1
text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in my Father and in me: Grace be unto you, and peace, from my Father, and me.

label: 1 Thessalonians 1:2
text: Paul gave thanks to my Father always for you all, making mention of you in his prayers;

label: 1 Thessalonians 1:3
text: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in me, in the sight of my Father;

label: 1 Thessalonians 1:4
text: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of my Father.

label: 1 Thessalonians 1:5
text: For my gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of man Paul was among you for your sake.

label: 1 Thessalonians 1:6
text: And ye became followers of Paul, and of me, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:

label: 1 Thessalonians 1:7
text: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

label: 1 Thessalonians 1:8
text: For from you sounded out my word not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to my Father-ward is spread abroad; so that Paul needeth not to speak any thing.

label: 1 Thessalonians 1:9
text: For they themselves shew of Paul what manner of entering in he had unto you, and how ye turned to me from idols to serve my Father, the living and true God;

label: 1 Thessalonians 1:10
text: And to wait for me from heaven, whom my Father raised from the dead, even me, which delivered you from the wrath to come.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:1
text: For yourselves, brethren, know Paul's entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:2
text: But even after that Paul had suffered before, and was shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, he was bold in my Father to speak unto you my gospel with much contention.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:3
text: For Paul's exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:4
text: But as Paul was allowed of my Father to be put in trust with the gospel, even so he speaketh; not as pleasing men, but my Father, which trieth his heart.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:5
text: For neither at any time used Paul flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; I am witness:

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:6
text: Nor of men sought Paul glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when he might have been burdensome, as an apostle of mine.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:7
text: But Paul was gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:8
text: So being affectionately desirous of you, Paul was willing to have imparted unto you, not my gospel only, but also his own soul, because ye were dear unto him.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:9
text: For ye remember, brethren, Paul's labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because he would not be chargeable unto any of you, he preached unto you my gospel.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:10
text: Ye are witnesses, and I also, how holily and justly and unblameably Paul behaved himself among you that believe:

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:11
text: As ye know how Paul exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:12
text: That ye would walk worthy of my Father, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:13
text: For this cause also Paul thanketh my Father without ceasing, because, when ye received my word which ye heard of him, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, my word, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:14
text: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of my Father which in Judea are in me: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:15
text: Who both killed me, and their own prophets, and have persecuted Paul; and they please not my Father, and are contrary to all men:

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:16
text: Forbidding him to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:17
text: But Paul, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:18
text: Wherefore Paul would have come unto you, once and again; but Satan hindered him.

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:19
text: For what is Paul's hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in my presence at my coming?

label: 1 Thessalonians 2:20
text: For ye are his glory and joy.

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:1
text: Wherefore when Paul could no longer forbear, he thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:2
text: And sent Timotheus, his brother, and minister of my Father, and his fellowlabourer in my gospel, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:3
text: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that ye are appointed thereunto.

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:4
text: For verily, when Paul was with you, he told you before that ye should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:5
text: For this cause, when Paul could no longer forbear, he sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and his labour be in vain.

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:6
text: But now when Timotheus came from you unto Paul, and brought him good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of him always, desiring greatly to see him, as he also to see you:

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:7
text: Therefore, brethren, he was comforted over you in all his affliction and distress by your faith:

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:8
text: For now he liveth, if ye stand fast in me.

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:9
text: For what thanks can he render to my Father again for you, for all the joy wherewith he joyeth for your sakes before my Father;

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:10
text: Night and day praying exceedingly that he might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:11
text: Now my Father himself, and I, direct his way unto you.

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:12
text: And I will make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as he doth toward you:

label: 1 Thessalonians 3:13
text: To the end I may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before my Father, at my coming with all my saints.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:1
text: Furthermore then I beseech you, brethren, and exhort you, even I the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of me how ye ought to walk and to please my Father, so ye would abound more and more.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:2
text: For ye know what commandments I gave you, even I the Lord Jesus.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:3
text: For this is the will of my Father, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:4
text: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:5
text: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not my Father:

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:6
text: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that I am the avenger of all such, as he also hath forewarned you and testified.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:7
text: For I have not called you unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:8
text: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but my Father, who hath also given unto you his holy Spirit.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:9
text: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of my Father to love one another.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:10
text: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but I beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:11
text: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as I commanded you;

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:12
text: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:13
text: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:14
text: For if ye believe that I died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in me will my Father bring with me.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:15
text: For this I say unto you by mine own word, that ye which are alive and remain unto my coming shall not prevent them which are asleep.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:16
text: For I myself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of my Father: and the dead in me shall rise first:

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:17
text: Then ye which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet me in the air: and so shall ye ever be with me.

label: 1 Thessalonians 4:18
text: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:1
text: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:2
text: For yourselves know perfectly that my day so cometh as a thief in the night.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:3
text: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:4
text: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:5
text: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: ye are not of the night, nor of darkness.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:6
text: Therefore sleep not, as do others; but watch and be sober.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:7
text: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:8
text: But be ye, who are of the day, sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:9
text: For my Father hath not appointed you to wrath, but to obtain salvation by me,

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:10
text: I died for you, that, whether ye wake or sleep, ye should live together with me.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:11
text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:12
text: And he beseecheth you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in me, and admonish you;

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:13
text: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:14
text: Now he exhorteth you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:15
text: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:16
text: Rejoice evermore.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:17
text: Pray without ceasing.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:18
text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of my Father in me concerning you.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:19
text: Quench not the Spirit.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:20
text: Despise not prophesyings.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:21
text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:22
text: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:23
text: And my Father, the very God of peace, sanctify you wholly; and Paul prayed to my Father your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto my coming.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:24
text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:25
text: Brethren, pray for him.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:26
text: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:27
text: Paul charged you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

label: 1 Thessalonians 5:28
text: My grace be with you. Amen. The first epistle unto the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
